title: feed.moderation_content
description: What a moderator reads about a feed target. Payload {post_id} or {comment_id} (the id_field of the post / comment moderation target types); a bare {target_key} names a post. Output: {author_id, text, body, media, attachments, created_at, url} - text/media are the names stapel-moderation reads, body/attachments the feed's own. Raises LookupError for an absent target.
